title: Michael Talbot dies of the leukemia he wrote about in his vampire novel

tellings.quote: I visited him at the hospital before his death. And the irony of Michael Talbot's death is is that he had written a novel about a vampire novel in which he claimed that vampireism was a rare form of leukemia and then he contracted a rare form of leukemia that killed him.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of the mind and psychic experience, says he visited his friend Michael Talbot, author of a book called The Holographic Universe, in the hospital before Talbot died in 1992. He points to an irony: Talbot had written a vampire novel in which vampirism was a rare form of leukemia, a blood cancer, and then Talbot died of a rare form of leukemia himself.
